lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from high-density clusters on the head to a grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a grid-like matrix in the mid-body lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct longitudinal ridges visible along the upper flank with a sharp luminance contrast—high intensity on the dorsal edge of the ridge and shadowed gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly intricate vermiculated (maze-like) white patterning on the anterior-most dorsal surface of the head; presence of a single Echeneidae specimen (remora) attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
